title: rosa canina var. vinealis
intro: Rosa canina var. vinealis, commonly known as Dwarf Wild Rose, is a deciduous shrub that is native to Europe and Western Asia. It is valued for its medicinal and culinary properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. vinealis include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which help to treat skin conditions, wounds, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable natural remedy.
